title: PHPUnit reports a renderer syntax check failure
root_cause: Renderer.php omits a semicolon after the return expression, so PHP cannot parse it. The PHPUnit test runs php -l and fails its exit-code assertion when linting returns 255.

relevant_evidence.why: The PHP parser error appears before the PHPUnit failure.
The return statement lacks its terminator.
The test runs the syntax checker and asserts its exit status.
